limitations: 论文使用 Llama3 405B 名称；这里明确采用发布的 Llama3.1 405B 几何。

llama4_maverick.name: Llama 4 Maverick 17B 128E（文本骨干）
llama4_maverick.source_scope: Named Meta Maverick builder and text component implementations; gated checkpoint not downloaded.
limitations: 文本骨干；不含视觉编码器及投影器。

measurement.request_tpot_definition: 测量窗内完整可见输出请求的 (最后Token-首Token)/(输出Token数-1)，再按请求等权算术平均；少于2个输出未定义。
measurement.non_slo_diagnostics: 最大请求TPOT、TBT分布、系统迭代仅单独报告，不当作同一个100ms均值门槛。
measurement.slo_note: 论文未公开精确聚合口径；同时报告平均/最大 TBT、平均/最大请求 TPOT 和系统迭代，不能混为同一个值。
measurement.decode_ingress_ttft: 外部已完成Prefill的请求到达Decode入口至本节点首个可见输出；包含PD/准入等待，不含外部Prefill计算。
measurement.output_count_basis: 外部只提供输入prompt的KV；本节点真实生成声明的全部输出，首输出仍付实际Decode成本；TPOT分母为D-1。
measurement.window: 原生闭环预热一个输出生命周期、测量两个生命周期，排除最终 drain；实际事件定义边界。
measurement.normalization: 同模型、负载、GPU 数、精度及 SLO 口径，除以各自原生 HBM4 基线。
measurement.cross_paper_difference: 原生结果与论文图标注的差异是跨实现对照，不是快速模式的预测误差。

execution_policy.pilot_fidelity: bounded native physical execution; no forecast
execution_policy.formal_fidelity: 原生物理预热和测量窗，无预测尾段；现有单GPU/dense fast guard不扩为多GPU/MoE，10%约束不变。无预测不代表对真实硬件或论文误差小于10%。
execution_policy.unsupported_behavior: 标记 pending/unsupported；不转入 paper_*，不免费写 KV、不给 plus 增配 HBM。

deployment_search.implementation: 脚本只枚举原生 ParallelSpec，调用同一 run_scenario；不计算替代算子时延。
deployment_search.dp_scope: 独立原生实例作为副本；原生无 dp_degree，不能添加不存在的 ParallelSpec 字段；共享 NIC 须共享资源，不能直接乘吞吐。
deployment_search.pp_scope: 先检查原生 DAG 的微批阶段重叠，未验证前不声称 GPipe 重叠。
deployment_search.batch_search: 本轮只实际执行批量1和8，选择通过SLO者中吞吐最高的一项；不是论文最大批量或全局最优搜索。后续部署搜索另行安排。

metadata.protocol_basis: generic_nand; the article does not specify OCP
metadata.paper_page_basis: 4 KiB read page is explicit; same program-page unit is a local modeling assumption
metadata.host_granularity_basis: explicit local transfer quantum, distinct from the published 4 KiB media page
metadata.partial_page_basis: explicit local policy; read_modify_write pays NandCore's old-page read, internal transfer and page program; reject disallows partial programs. Neither policy is given in the paper
metadata.paper_read_staging_execution: native per-bank two-page read buffers; array, internal and host transfers retain independent resource calendars and live-reader overwrite dependencies; read requests drive fills, without an autonomous predictive prefetch controller
metadata.native_read_cache_unit_basis: Two native page-buffer slots per actual die/plane. HBF: 16 dies * 25 planes * 2 slots * 4096 bytes = 3276800 bytes = 3.125 MiB per stack; the paper's 3.13-MB label is interpreted as rounded binary MiB for this native organization, not 3130000 decimal bytes. CONV: 16 * 16 * 2 * 4096 = 2097152 bytes = 2 MiB per stack, below either interpretation of 3.13 MB. No extra staging arena or intermediate SRAM is created.
metadata.native_read_cache_scope: NandCore page-buffer lifetimes and paid physical transfers; not a separately modeled SRAM port or GPU activation workspace
metadata.paper_intermediate_sram_execution: native SramCore and ordinary allocator/workspace lifetime; authored by exploring_hbf_native_config, not this NAND-only builder

research_assumptions.basis: Local mechanism control only: 256 pages/block, whole-block covering capacity, 2 ms erase, 100 GB/s per die-channel, one aggregate full-duplex host link, 4096 global combined credits with writes sharing those credits, 4 KiB host-transfer granularity and paid read-modify-write for partial program pages. These are local choices, not parameters sourced from this paper; OCP is not selected.

additional_research_assumptions: one core channel per actual die; stack membership represented by consecutive groups of 16 channels
one aggregate host link; explicit host-transfer granularity; zero fixed front delay
two native read-cache pages per actual die/plane, no host-ack write staging; partial programs use the explicitly selected paid RMW/reject policy

Two native page-buffer slots per actual die/plane. HBF: 16 dies * 25 planes * 2 slots * 4096 bytes = 3276800 bytes = 3.125 MiB per stack; the paper's 3.13-MB label is interpreted as rounded binary MiB for this native organization, not 3130000 decimal bytes. CONV: 16 * 16 * 2 * 4096 = 2097152 bytes = 2 MiB per stack, below either interpretation of 3.13 MB. No extra staging arena or intermediate SRAM is created.
generic direct-address page service; no automatic erases, write-order enforcement or GC
whole-block covering capacity is not a disclosed reserve or overprovisioning ratio

findings: 第十三轮LONG B1候选（只跑1层窗口，第十二轮超时作废后重跑）839.185秒结束，预测拒绝：层级（单批）条件预算7.538243%已过10%门槛，拒绝来自服务窗口指标（测量时长±43.05%、集群吞吐±43.05%、平均TPOT±51.47%、平均TTFT±40.36%）。单侧预算合成与发射顺序证明同第十二轮，另给未来上下文相位契约加了REF来源资格与相位缓存；物理样本和PD账与第十一轮1层窗口精确一致，壁钟为历史非ABBA。正式30点仍暂停。
第十二轮（1层窗口）在2009秒时越过1800秒上限：层预算已过10%门槛，但未来上下文相位契约未缓存REF来源资格证明而空转；按用户要求停止并记为超时无效，修复后以第十三轮重跑。
第十一轮同参数LONG B1候选745.856秒结束，预测拒绝，整批条件预算14.967917%。AllReduce改为只在REF周期影响的轮次收重开、其余按命中收后，每层状态保护降为16407.76ns；完整物理样本和PD账与第十轮保存记录精确一致，壁钟为历史非ABBA。正式30点仍暂停。
第十轮同参数LONG B1候选794.770秒结束，预测拒绝，整批条件预算17.019904%。行0一致性证明推广到层内全部HBM IO并收紧无冲突活动上界后，每层状态保护降为18697.04ns；完整物理样本和PD账与第九轮保存记录精确一致，壁钟为历史非ABBA。正式30点仍暂停。
第九轮同参数LONG B1候选764.346秒结束，预测拒绝，整批条件预算30.626729%。真实分配器地址与bank-row一致性证明使每层状态保护降为33877.36ns；完整物理样本和PD账与第八轮保存记录精确一致，壁钟为历史非ABBA。正式30点仍暂停。
第八轮同参数LONG B1候选699.561秒结束，预测拒绝，整批条件预算36.047831%。每层状态保护39925.36ns；完整物理样本和PD账与第七轮保存记录精确一致，壁钟为历史非ABBA。263项联合检查通过，正式30点仍暂停。
第七轮LONG B1快速候选684.436秒（11分24秒）结束，连续窗口1/2/4层的整批条件预算分别为67.590262%、67.574336%、67.560708%，均超过10%；真实预测拒绝，吞吐、TTFT、TPOT保持空值。正式30点继续暂停。
有依据的初态保护修正使1层预算从第六轮93.186330%降到67.590262%；扩大到4层只再改善0.029554个百分点。三轮校验漂移均为0，每层合成状态保护仍为75060.32ns，继续堆相同样本收益很小。
一次候选累计12个完整物理窗口、28次层执行，窗口内状态连续；各档独立保留2组校准和2组校验，不把前档重叠样本计作后档独立证据。PD仅完整导入1请求，完整批次、Decode、可见和预测Token仍均为0。
真实PD边界耗时386.971秒；三档采样与预算分别30.599、52.652、100.938秒。复用同一入站、原生准备及层外样本；总计时不因扩窗重置，1800秒上限保持。历史壁钟不提供ABBA端到端加速结论。
